# Browlens

> Browlens is a brow app for eyebrow mapping, shape editing, balance analysis, and virtual eyebrow filter previews on a photo.

Brow mapping, local analysis, and outline editing are free without sign-up. AI-generated photo previews are a separate step that requires an account and credits. Current generation costs and download options are shown in the product and pricing page.

The editor has six adjustable control points: the head, arch, and tail of each eyebrow. Balance reports describe differences in image pixels, not physical millimeters or a beauty score. Generated previews are visual references and do not guarantee a particular styling result.

## Eyebrow guides

- [Eyebrow mapping guide](https://browlens.com/blog/eyebrow-mapping-guide): Explains the head, arch, and tail reference points, six-point editing, and how to interpret a brow balance report.
- [Eyebrow shapes guide](https://browlens.com/blog/eyebrow-shapes-guide): Introduces brow shape terminology and ways to compare styles.
- [How to shape eyebrows](https://browlens.com/blog/how-to-shape-eyebrows): A beginner's workflow for planning a shape before changing the actual brows.

## Product

- [Brow app](https://browlens.com/): Upload a photo, inspect brow mapping, adjust the shape, and explore a photo preview.
- [Eyebrow filter](https://browlens.com/filter): A shorter try-on workflow with automatic placement and preset shapes.
- [Pricing](https://browlens.com/pricing): Current plans, credits, and export options.
